nos_units.nos_title: Prepare itinerary and finalize tour package for customer
kus: KU1. organizational policies on discounts, promotional packages, loyalty programs, etc.
KU2. government rules for travel to the target destinations (inbound and outbound) like visa, prohibited products, customs regulations for international travellers, etc.
KU3. international norms and practices for tour and travel industry
KU4. different customer categories and relevant tour packages/travel plans
KU5. customer's profile to make appropriate recommendations
KU6. categories of hotel, tariff plans for different types of rooms, applicable taxes, meal plans,
KU7. popular seasonal packages and destinations
KU8. travel advisory and insurance requirements for the package
KU9. logistics involved in the tour package
KU10. documents required for travel booking and tour packaging
KU11. the process of invoicing and billing the customer
KU12. travel partner details, e.g., hotel, travel agents, transport providers, etc.
KU13. airline policies on domestic and international travel like baggage allowance, meals, etc.
KU14. currency and exchange rates of international destinations
KU15. grievance redressal for handling dissatisfied customer or partner
KU16. types of tour itinerary like adventure, health, cultural, religious etc.
KU17. factors to be considered for itinerary preparation
KU18. components and considerations for tour costs
KU19. travel pricing and distribution mechanism
KU20. types and characteristics of pricing strategies
KU21. cash management process
KU22. digital payment methods
KU23. GDS and other booking engines for e.g. Galileo, Amadeus, etc.
gs: GS1. read company policies, instructions, etc.
GS2. communicate effectively and patiently with customers to assist in the tour planning
GS3. negotiate any customizations/modifications requested to minimize discount costs and losses
GS4. negotiate with service providers/partners like airlines, hotels, transport services for itinerary
GS5. identify and solve issues to avoid delay in tour planning

modules.module_title: Determine customer's travel needs and plan the tour

pcs.pc_description: arrange resources such as brochures, travel books/magazine, and other sources of information on famous destinations, along with railway timetables and airlines schedule
greet and welcome the customer as per standards
assess the type of travel the customers are looking for, such as leisure, business, adventure package, etc.

identify the travel details like preferred destination, planned duration and tentative dates, preferred mode of travel, accommodation preferences, estimated budget, and number of persons travelling etc.
determine the type of group of customers travelling together such as family, friends, colleagues, etc.
assess the customer's specifications and wishes
suggest travel options that best suit customer’s needs
suggest some destinations with tourist attractions, experiences to have, etc. to customers who have not planned any particular travel destination
provide detailed information on climate, distance, tourist attractions, and any upcoming festival/entertainment event to help customer choose the package
stay updated with the latest/daily tariff market trend
collect information on other travel agency’s package rates for the destination to offer a better deal
analyze the cost of travel by different modes of transportation to the destination
negotiate with partners/service provider for hotel bookings, tickets, transportation, guide/tour escort, etc. for the best rates
estimate and inform customer regarding cost of meal, shopping, entrance fees of tourist attractions, guides, etc. based on the destination’s cost of living
prepare a ballpark estimate by adding up different cost factors including miscellaneous expenses and markup
inform the customers on the terms and conditions of payment and other details
confirm the destination and the travel package, including the estimated cost with the customer
plan an end-to-end travel route such that nearby locations, important tourist attractions are clubbed and covered within the available time
consider details like interest and energy level of the tourists, etc. while planning the itinerary

update the itinerary with the details like distance between locations, estimated time for every activity, opening and closing time of places of attraction along with information on the background, various restaurant options, etc.
inform the customer about airlines’ luggage limits, required travel and medical insurance details, visa processing, passport, currency, and other requirements
offer unique insights, trivia, and activity ideas, insider tips etc. for the destination
inform the customers of the estimated cost and taxes of the ticket fare for the various travel options such as railway, airlines, bus, cab and cruise
check on the availability of tickets at the preferred dates
collect the documents and other required details from the customers for ticket booking as per standards
check the itinerary, insurance, visa etc. to book the tickets accordingly
inform the customer regarding the baggage restrictions, penalties for overweight luggage, prohibited items for cabin luggage
book tickets for flights/trains/other modes of transport, reserve accommodation in hotels/lodges, and arrange for local transportation
confirm booking with customer names and other details with hotels, airlines, and other transport agents
coordinate with the appropriate agencies on cultural events, entertainment, etc. arranged during the travel

modules.module_title: Handover final tour package to customer

pcs.pc_description: coordinate with customers to collect payment
create and update records of clients manually or electronically, as applicable
handover the final package with tour details, and relevant documents like invoice, hotel booking confirmation, tickets, etc.
update the itinerary and add travel details like start and end dates, routes, reservation and confirmation numbers, types of transportation, connection information, rentals, etc. in the itinerary
mention lodging details like name of lodging, arrival and check-out dates, lodging address, phone number, fax, website, email ID, reservation numbers, etc.
provide relevant travel information, weather forecast and handy travel tools like destination maps/guides to the customer
advise customers on possible issues during the travel like safety, currency, etc., in specific locations
provide health related information such as medical facilities available at the destination, services like air ambulance, vaccination guidelines, etc.
provide details of consulate/high commission at the destination

nos_units.nos_title: Assess travel risks and arrange insurance policy for customer
kus: KU1. Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (IRDA) regulations
KU2. international travel and safety norms as per International Air Transport Association (IATA),
KU3. various risks associated with travelling
KU4. different types of travel policies and their features
KU5. factors affecting the cost of travel insurance
KU6. insurance premium calculation procedure based on travel type, age of customer, etc.
KU7. epidemic or regional outbreak of diseases that may affect the terms of the policy
KU8. essential documents and other requirements for travel insurance policy application
KU9. travel insurance claims procedure
KU10. insurance coverage details like flight cancellation, lost luggage, sudden illness, and hospitalization, etc.
KU11. health check-ups and vaccinations required for particular destinations
KU12. the process to create quotes and invoices
KU13. methods to identify fraudulent claims
KU14. different modes of receiving payment
KU15. daily cash management process
KU16. MS Office and other software for insurance policy claims
gs: GS1. read and interpret all insurance policies
GS2. communicate effectively with customers to assist in insurance application and claims process
GS3. identify immediate or temporary solutions to resolve delay, rejections or other problems related to insurance application processing
GS4. fill-up the checklist of the documents to be submitted for insurance
GS5. fill-in forms and other travel insurance documents to complete the processing
GS6. record customer's information related to the booking

modules.module_title: Assess customer needs and suggest insurance policy

pcs.pc_description: interact with the customers to understand their purpose, nature, destination, duration of travel, etc.
analyze the risks associated with the customer’s travel plan
determine the areas of risk exposure through customer interaction
estimate the cost of insurance cover for the travel

explain various travel risks covered by the travel insurance policy to the customers such as trip cancellation, travel delays/interruptions, loss of baggage, unforeseen events, emergency medical expenses, accidents and death, etc. and the duration of cover
inform the customers about features of travel insurance policies like the type of policy, claims process, the amount that can be recovered, etc.
explain the differences in the various insurance policies and the amount that can be recovered via claims
brief the customers on complete terms and conditions of the policy and statutory requirements
arrange for stipulated medical check-up of the customer as per company’s policy or statutory requirements
check the eligibility of the customers to be insured
brief the customers on the expenses and the documents required for purchasing the travel insurance and the premium

collect all relevant documents from the customer, e.g., identity and address proof, medical test reports, photographs for application forms, etc., and cross-check for any missing or additional documents if required
ensure that the application form is completely filled and signed by the customer
verify the authenticity of the details in the application form
check photocopies against original documents like medical records, education records, travel documents, etc.
prepare the final quote and invoice for the customer

modules.module_title: Coordinate with insurance agent for processing and handover insurance policy to the customer

pcs.pc_description: submit documents to the insurance agent for processing within the specified time limit
follow up on the approval and process completion status using the application reference number
resolve any issues/rejections and reapply for the customer
coordinate with insurance agents for speedy processing of policy
collect the completed insurance policy documents from the agents and check if the details on the received policy matches the customer details
assure customer of all kinds of assistance in insurance claims processing if there is medical emergency/mishap during the tour
e-mail the original policy document to the customer

kus: KU1. types of visas (business, tourist, work permit, family, etc.)
KU2. visa requirement and eligibility criteria to visit different countries
KU3. visa application and processing procedure for different destinations
KU4. immigration laws and procedures of different countries
KU5. modalities of short term/ long term visa
KU6. consulate and embassy rules and regulations
KU7. MS office and softwares related to visa and immigration
gs: GS1. read the visa requirements, documents, and policies
GS2. prepare a checklist of the documents to be submitted for visa
GS3. communicate effectively with customers to assist in the visa application process
GS4. fill-in forms and other visa documents for customers to complete the visa processing
GS5. identify immediate or temporary solutions to resolve delay or other problems related to the

modules.module_title: Brief about visa requirements and collect relevant documents and fees

pcs.pc_description: check required visa type (tourist, business, student, work permit, dependent, sponsored, etc.) based on customer’s purpose of travel, duration of stay, and number of destinations
prepare the list of the required documents based on the type of travel and the specified destination
conduct a test interview with the customers to understand and ensure their stand on the suitability and eligibility for the visa approval
brief the customer on visa regulations/requirements of the destination(s) like immigration policy, sponsorship obligations, etc.
inform the customer about the required documents such as passport, photograph, supporting documents, etc. based on the type of travel and the specified destination
brief the customer on the typical waiting time for visa processing based on the destination and country of origin
explain the non-refundable policies of visa application (even if a visa is denied)
collect all relevant documents from the customer, e.g., identity and address proof, medical test reports, photographs for application forms, educational certificates, etc.
cross-check for any missing documents
check the validity of passport and eligibility to apply visa for the specified destination
ensure the details given in the application form is accurate and true
fill up the application form for the customer, if required
collect visa processing fee from the customers
submit the required documents to the consulate

modules.module_title: Arrange visa interview and liaise with the embassy and consulate

pcs.pc_description: check with embassy/consulate for visa interview date for customer on submission of the documents
brief the customer about the date and time of the scheduled visa interview
inform the consulate in case the customer is unable to keep the scheduled appointment
coordinate for an alternate day to schedule the interview
track the visa processing status, using the reference number of the application submitted
take corrective action in case visa is rejected
follow-up on pending visa and stamped passport to be received

modules.module_title: Collect and hand over the approved visas

pcs.pc_description: collect the stamped passport on receiving information from the consulate (over phone or email)
check if received visa details correctly match with the customer’s travel plan
inform the customers on receipt of visa approval and passport
brief the customer on the various terms and conditions and validity of the visa, category, legal guidelines, etc.

modules.module_title: Record and document the visa process

pcs.pc_description: record and update the customer's information related to the booking for future reference and ensure data protection
prepare monthly reports on visa applications/approvals for the management records

nos_units.nos_title: Provide assistance to the customers during the tour
kus: KU1. tour tracking and monitoring methods
KU2. redress mechanism in case of customer complaints
KU3. partner network details for tour packages
KU4. helplines for customers during the tour
KU5. travel advisories for different destinations
KU6. details of travel insurance policy and visa for the tour
KU7. immigration laws and procedures of different countries
KU8. customs regulations for different countries
KU9. vaccinations required for particular destinations
KU10. information regarding travel destinations such as local laws, weather, language, culture,
gs: GS1. communicate effectively with customers to assist during tour
GS2. provide immediate or temporary solutions to resolve delay or other problems during the tour
GS3. maintain trust and reliability right from the first interaction with customer till end of tour

modules.module_title: Apprise customers of any change in the planned itinerary

pcs.pc_description: keep track of the customers’ tour to ensure smooth journey
inform the customers regarding any alteration in the planned itinerary like cancellations, delays, rescheduling, etc. while they are on trip
convince the customers politely in case of any deviation in the planned itinerary
suggest an appropriate alternative to the customer as compensation
assist the customers in changing or/upgrading the planned itinerary while on tour, if required
ensure the altered service offer matches customer expectations
help customer with any health, legal, transportation, cancellations, or any other issue that they may face during tour
provide prompt support in processing insurance claims in case of medical emergency
coordinate with local police or embassy or any other authority for any legal assistance to the customer
arrange for alternate transportation/evacuation in case of breakdowns, sudden cancellations, natural calamity and riots, etc.
update records with customer details and their travel information
ensure customer’s personal data is secured and handled appropriately
document all customer details on a monthly basis
keep record of all bills, payments, and invoices specific to the customer packages
record the feedback received from the customer through e-mails, phones, apps or in person
take prompt action on customer complaints/dissatisfaction
